name: Jobstreet suspicious-account blocking and application removal

attribution.legal_posture: First-party employer, platform, or hiring-service disclosure with defensive guidance; legal attribution remains at source and service level.

caveats: Jobstreet's page is limited to platform-level guidance; count, identifiers, labeling method, case details, and publication date are unreported. Platform enforcement should allow lawful review and remediation of false positives.
The excluded packages contain no Jobstreet or SEEK first-party DPRK enforcement disclosure.
This record carries no identification or inference of an unnamed customer, applicant, identity-theft victim, or account.
Source-reported product or platform outcome statements require independent audit for efficacy claims.

statements: Jobstreet states that it monitors the DPRK fraudulent-employment campaign, detects and blocks suspicious candidate accounts, and proactively removes applications from actors it identifies as North Korean so those applications are no longer visible to hirers.
Use stolen identities and deepfake assistance to create candidate accounts
Use local facilitators to receive employer laptops and enable remote access
Apply through employment platforms while concealing true location
limitations: Jobstreet publishes no count, account identifiers, labeling method, or case details, and the page exposes no reliable publication date. Platform enforcement should allow lawful review and remediation of false positives.
No Jobstreet or SEEK first-party DPRK enforcement disclosure was found in the excluded packages.

statements: Platform-side detection and blocking of suspicious accounts
Remove confirmed campaign applications from employer queues
Use verified credentials, live practical tasks, and at least one higher-assurance interaction for high-risk roles
Monitor overlapping or unusual login infrastructure without treating one IP or time-zone signal as proof
limitations: Signals require lawful, proportionate, accessible, privacy-preserving human review. Accent, ethnicity, nationality, visual similarity, camera behavior, geography, VPN use, remote work, or one device/network attribute must never act as a standalone detector.
